components.note: Factorials, binomial coefficients (zero outside range), natural logs, the ratio meaning of ~ (Durrett p. 113; Feller (9.1) p. 52), independent fair signs S_N and lattice L_N (Durrett p. 113 setup), B_N, phi/Phi with normalization proved on the route, rounding and empty-supremum conventions are all stated.

Durrett Lemma 3.1.1 (p. 114) and Exercise 3.1.1 (p. 115) are stated with the source hypotheses and proved with written steps (|log(1+t)-t| <= t^2, then exponentiation); Feller's expansion (8.11) (p. 51) is derived with an explicit vanishing remainder.

Feller VI.3 (3.3)-(3.6) (p. 151): geometric-ratio bound (3.4), the counting argument for (3.5) and the left tail via failures (3.6) are proved; Feller VII.1 Lemma 2 (1.7)-(1.8) (p. 175) is proved by the derivative comparison (1.9) of p. 179. Mathematics present with written steps: (9.2)-(9.12) with d_n and Delta_n, (9.13)-(9.15) (both Robbins bounds, strict decrease of r_n), footnote 17's refinement with explicit bound 6/(5n^5), the constant by Feller VII.2 footnote 3 (central ratio, interval mass, VI (3.5) tail, (1.8) bound; pp. 179-181) and an independent cosine-integral determination proved on the route. Missing: the source's attributions and stated claims listed in gap.

gamma(a) as in Durrett Exercise 3.1.3 (p. 115) with 0 log 0 = 0, I(a), and the log 0 = -infinity convention.

Declared extension of Durrett's fair-sign case: uniform local limit for fixed 0 < p < 1, convergence in distribution, exact interval indices, degenerate p = 0, 1, no claim for p = p_N; proved with explicit Taylor and factorial remainders.
